rbi.subtitle: Estimated income for next cycle
rbi.explanation:
Regenerative Basic Income is a periodic income distributed among Alternun users who contribute to the ecosystem.

It doesn't depend on how much money you have, but on your participation, commitment, and impact, measured through your AIRS score.

Each time Alternun facilitates a compensation, a sale from the compensation pool, or an economic activity within the platform, part of that value goes directly to the RBI fund.

message.regenerative: Join AIRS: Make the impact you help create visible
message.welcome: Welcome to AIRS: Your actions can build reputation
message.earn: Build your AIRS Score: Turn verified actions into a track record
message.community: Join the Green Circle: People, businesses, and projects building a more regenerative economy

info.summaryLine: AIRS turns verified actions into a reputation you build over time. It makes your contribution visible and can unlock access to benefits, projects, opportunities, and new ways to participate in the value the ecosystem helps create.

media.subtitle: Your actions can create impact. AIRS makes that impact visible, builds a verifiable track record, and turns your participation into reputation.
media.title: Impact that becomes reputation

elProyecto.sectionTitle: Your actions can build something that lasts
elProyecto.sectionDescriptionPart1: Many of the actions we take create impact, but that impact often disappears once the action is over. At
elProyecto.sectionDescriptionPart2: we turn those actions into a verifiable track record. AIRS makes your contribution visible, builds reputation over time, and connects that reputation to new opportunities within a regenerative economy.

airs.overview: is your impact and reputation score. It is built through verified actions within the ecosystem and keeps a record of your contribution over time. It cannot be bought or transferred: it is built through participation.
airs.subtitle: Your track record, made visible
airs.title: AIRS

atn.overview: is the token that helps coordinate and move value across the ecosystem. It connects participants, projects, and opportunities, and is one of the ways value generated by the ecosystem can flow back to the community.
atn.subtitle: Coordination & Value Token
atn.title: ATN

rbi.overview: is the mechanism through which part of the value generated by ecosystem activities and projects can flow back to eligible participants. Its distribution depends on the value available and on participation recognized through AIRS.
rbi.subtitle: Regenerative Basic Income
rbi.title: RBI

comoFunciona.sectionTitle: How AIRS turns your actions into a track record
comoFunciona.subtitle: Act. Verify. Build reputation. Unlock new possibilities.

s1.b2: Choose how you want to participate

s2.b1: Participate in verified actions and missions

s3.b1: Your AIRS Score grows with your contribution
s3.b3: Your reputation can unlock new levels of access
s3.description: AIRS turns isolated actions into cumulative reputation that can unlock benefits, opportunities, and new ways to participate in the ecosystem.
s3.title: Build your reputation

s4.b3: Participate in the value created when eligible
s4.description: When the ecosystem creates value, part of that value can flow back to eligible participants through RBI, creating a cycle where impact, reputation, and shared prosperity reinforce one another.

membresia.sectionTitle: Your track record starts on Day 1
membresia.descriptionPart1: You don't need to pay a membership fee to start building it.
membresia.descriptionPart2Bold: Every verified action can become part of your story within AIRS.
membresia.descriptionPart3: Your AIRS Score is cumulative and follows your participation over time.
membresia.descriptionPart4: Your score remains with you, while your level of participation and access evolves as you continue to contribute.
membresia.descriptionLine1: No monthly fees or renewals are required.
membresia.descriptionLine2Bold: Your track record starts with your first verified action.
membresia.descriptionLine3Prefix: From that moment, every eligible action can add to your
membresia.descriptionLine3Suffix: you build within the ecosystem. Your score is cumulative, while access to benefits and opportunities depends on your participation and the rules in effect.

eco.description: Make eligible everyday decisions part of your AIRS track record.
eco.title: Everyday actions
eco.infoBody: Eligible products, services, and partner merchants can turn everyday decisions into verified actions within AIRS. That way, actions that once ended with a transaction become part of your track record.

experiencias.description: Take part in missions that protect, restore, or strengthen territories and communities, and make your contribution part of your AIRS track record.
experiencias.title: Conservation and regeneration missions
experiencias.infoBody: You can contribute time, resources, or direct participation. Each mission defines from the start which actions are verifiable, how they contribute to the goal, and how they are recognized within AIRS.

marketplace.description: Access a marketplace of regenerative products and services.
marketplace.title: Marketplace

premium.description: Recognize part of the footprint you create and support verified initiatives that help compensate for it.
premium.title: Compensation missions
premium.infoBody: Not every impact created by our daily activities can be avoided. AIRS allows you to voluntarily support verified compensation initiatives and make that action part of your track record.

cursos.description: The AIRS Card will connect eligible purchases to your identity and automatically record verifiable activity.
cursos.title: AIRS card
cursos.infoBody: The AIRS Card will connect eligible spending, partner merchants, and impact in one experience, allowing certain everyday decisions to become part of your track record automatically.

services.description: Verified services that contribute to positive impact.
services.title: Services

beneficios.sectionTitle: How to build your AIRS Score
beneficios.subtitle: Your reputation grows through verifiable actions: compensating for your footprint, choosing eligible products and services, contributing time or resources to missions, and participating in regenerative projects.

communityTotal.label: Global AIRS balance accumulated by the platform
communityTotal.tooltipMeaning: AIRS is Alternun's impact and reputation score. It is not money, cannot be purchased, and is not a redeemable balance: it represents a track record built through verified actions.
communityTotal.tooltipMoneyLoading: For allied commerce, the earning reference is 5 AIRS for each eligible US$1. We are loading the total to show that reference.
communityTotal.tooltipMoney: In allied commerce, {{amount}} is the eligible-purchase reference for earning this total at 5 AIRS per US$1. The total may also include other activities.
communityTotal.tooltipImpact: There is no fixed AIRS-to-CO₂ conversion: each action or credit depends on a reduction or offset that has been measured and verified.
